summary: Tested Onboarding Voice Interview end-to-end (backend + frontend). All 7 pytest backend tests pass (status shape, sessions/{sid} 200/401/404, rebuild re-runs LLM and persists persona.bio without em-dashes, DELETE /voice no-op, public twiml wrong-token 404, public call/status 204, /api/scripts regression). Frontend: logged in as activation-tester and verified InterviewCard on /my-profile (title 'Jessi knows you', '11 of 11 things your VA knows came from you.', pill 'Voice ID: coming soon', buttons 'What Jessi learned' + 'Redo'); /interview/review shows header 'What Jessi learned Interview · today', summary 'Your VA, bio and card now sound like Activation - 20 details saved from a 1 minute call.', voice line 'Voice ID: coming soon', 8 interview-highlight-* rows, 20 interview-field-* rows with correct labels ('YOUR STORY' for bio, 'TITLE', 'YEARS IN THE BUSINESS', 'SPECIALTIES', 'HOMETOWN', ...), 33 interview-turn-* transcript bubbles, 'Edit details' and 'Hear your VA' CTAs. /settings/virtual-assistant shows compact InterviewCard right under completeness card which reads 'Your VA knows 11 of 11 things about you' (100%). Did NOT trigger /interview/start or click Redo confirm (main agent already ran that once and note says at-most-once). Voice ID reports 'not_configured' as expected (no PICOVOICE key).

bio extraction preserves no em-dashes (verified after rebuild); persona.bio equals extracted.bio and persona_interviewed_at is set

If you need to retest /interview/start (real Twilio call), do it ONLY as activation-tester (500-555-0006) and at most once; expect 'Your phone was busy' failure within ~45s.
